      Your Local Nurse Next Door Franchise

      Nurse Next Door Aurora


      Our Aurora location delivers reliable home care services to help your loved ones stay at home. We help seniors maintain their independence by supporting them where they need it. Whether you need dementia, Parkinson's, disability or post-surgery care, our in-home care services can help you.


      We offer support in personal care, meal preparations, 24-hour home care and more. Our custom in-home care model allows your loved ones to stay healthy and happy at home.

      Our Story

      Get Connected to our Care Team.

      Nurse Next Door Thornton, CO is proudly making lives better in the communities of Thornton, Brighton, Commerce City, Westminster, Broomfield, Northglenn, Henderson, North Denver providing 24 hour senior care services for you or your loved ones.

      Franchisees Justice & Doreen recognized the aging community in Thornton, Denver & Aurora, CO and the need for home care in those regions. They are focused on making a positive impact on the lives of their clients and Caregivers. They are driven by their commitment to making a difference and revolutionizing the standard for home care in the communities they serve.

      Justice and Doreen possess an extensive educational background in the fields of nursing and engineering. Their career paths diverged as Doreen dedicated her expertise to the healthcare sector, working in various settings such as nursing homes, hospitals, and detention facilities. In contrast, Justice channeled his skills towards roles in manufacturing and service industries, providing essential support in engineering-related positions.

      As passionate owners who have personally cared for a parent diagnosed with a terminal illness, their mission is deeply personal. They aspire to extend the same level of heartfelt care to individuals facing similar circumstances, approaching their mission as if they were tending to their own beloved parents. Their ultimate objective is to deliver compassionate care, driven by a profound sense of empathy and understanding.

      With a compassionate, dedicated and professional care team that is available 24/7, Nurse Next Door Thornton, CO mission is to make a difference in the lives of seniors, every day. Justice & Doreen and their team are ready to do everything they can to put a smile on the faces of their clients while helping them age happily and independently in the comforts of their own homes.

      They provide services across the full spectrum of care, including Alzhiemer's and alzheimers and dementia care, companionship care, homemaking, personal care, relief and respite care and transportation/accompaniment - all with no long-term contracts.

      We Make Getting Care Simple

      Step 1

      Instant Connection

      Your call is answered by a real person within 30 seconds, any time—day or night. Call us anytime to book a complimentary Caring Consult™. We listen to your needs—whether that’s elder care, personal care or recovery support—to learn how we can make your lives better.

      Step 2

      Getting to Know You

      A Care Designer meets with you, virtually or in person, to assess your needs and preferences before creating a Care Plan tailor-made for you. We match you with the perfect caregiver with the right skills, a kind heart and a personality you’ll love.

      Step 3

      First Visit

      We aim to send the same Caregiver every visit so you can grow your relationship with your perfect match Caregiver from day one. Our team stays in touch, monitoring care and making tweaks as needed throughout your care journey.

      Frequently asked Questions

      Button Text
      Contact Us

      What if I need to speak to someone after business hours?

      Our Care Services Center is open 24/7. Call anytime, and one of our Care Services Specialists will be happy to assist you.

      When should we consider 24-hour home care?

      Use this list to help you decide if continuous monitoring is something you should consider:

      • The person doesn’t sleep through the night (or gets up more than 2-3 times per night).
      • The person has difficulty moving around and is at a high risk of falls.
      • The person was recently (or is about to be) discharged from the hospital and needs constant monitoring.
      • The person’s spouse or relative is exhausted from helping day and night.

      If you are not sure, give us a call to this number 1-877-588-8609.

      How much does Nurse Next Door cost?

      Nurse Next Door's services vary in price depending on the level of care required and the Nurse Next Door Care team that services your area. To get a better idea of pricing in your area, speak to one of our Care Services Specialists—we're open any time, 24/7.

      We also offer a complimentary Caring Consult™, during which one of our care designers will help you determine the amount of care you may require. We'll then work with you to balance your budget and needs and find a home care option for you.

      ‍

      Can I trial Nurse Next Door or do I have to sign a long-term contract?

      You are not locked into a long-term contract as a Nurse Next Door client.

      To try out Nurse Next Door, just contact us to book a complimentary, no-obligation Caring Consult™. One of our care designers will visit your home to assess your needs and design a care plan with you, including frequency and duration of care.

      ‍

      Are your home care services only for seniors?

      No. We provide home care services to people of all ages. While our specialty is providing Happier Aging® experiences to seniors, we also assist with disability care, post-operative care, and more for children and adults. 

      Visit our services page to explore our full list of services.

      Will I have the same Care Team all the time?

      At Nurse Next Door, we strive to provide consistent care with regularly assigned caregivers. If your Caregiver isn’t available, we will ensure a suitable replacement that meets your unique needs.

      Does Nurse Next Door conduct a background check for Caregivers?

      Yes, all Nurse Next Door Caregivers are carefully screened with criminal background checks, vulnerable sector checks and reference checks. We verify our Caregivers' educational credentials upon hire and ensure, on an annual basis, that every Nurse is registered and in good standing with their respective College of Nurses.

      Why should I use Nurse Next Door instead of hiring a private caregiver?

      While private caregivers also offer personalized care, we go beyond that by matching you with the perfect Caregiver and providing a reliable system you can trust. Our 24/7 live support and activity monitoring system ensures you receive reliable, quality care every visit.
